component.name: M-Flasher
component.summary: Back up, restore and reinstall the firmware of M-VAVE synthesizers

description.p: M-Flasher backs up, restores and reinstalls the firmware of an M-VAVE FM-1 or SMK-37 Pro / Elite over USB, and installs m-bootloader. It talks to the chip's built-in USB download mode, so it also works when the firmware on the unit is broken.

ul.li: Back up the whole flash, and restore a backup
Install firmware from M-VAVE's .fwsc packages, as downloaded
Install m-bootloader, or put the stock one back
A flash map shows what will change before anything is written

description.p: Unofficial: not affiliated with M-VAVE or JieLi.

screenshot.caption: Connected to an SMK-37 Pro: the device, the operations and the flash map
